New York: A Pragnell ring sold for $475,000 at Heritage's Dallas sale, 90% above its $250,000 estimate.

The 22.09-carat fancy yellow led a $7.6 million sale from 425 lots. Four of the top five lots beat their estimates; pieces by Bulgari, Hermès and Tiffany also sold.

New York: Searches for Marie Antoinette jewelry jump 125% as Coppola's film turns 20.

The Château de Versailles opened a Petit Trianon exhibition on the film's anniversary; pearl-stud searches rose 9.6%, wedding-pearl searches 13.2%, JCK reports.
